item.text: The diff narrowed the remaining issues to three areas: alias preservation, mixed-key ordering, and merge handling. There’s also a stale `/output/lib/load_yaml.mjs` path showing up in one failure path, so I’m checking the live `/output` tree before patching those serializer rules.

I found the cause of the bizarre alias and recursion failures: the entrypoint and top-level CLI file in `/output` were still the earlier scaffold, so verification was executing the wrong code path. I’m replacing those top-level files and removing the stale helper modules before rerunning the differential tests.

The only remaining mismatch is first-use anchor emission: the anchor line is correct, but the body disappears because the emitter re-enters the same node and treats it as an alias on the second pass. I’m splitting “emit state” from “emit body” to remove that recursion artifact.
The main differential set is now clean. I’m doing one last pass on CLI edge cases and a few extra YAML normalization cases so the final files aren’t only matching the happy path.
